verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents telephony support for inbound/outbound voice agent calls (docs-5, docs-19) but the concrete implementation shown is a bridge pattern where Twilio owns the phone number and streams call audio to Deepgram's WebSocket (docs-18), not native phone-number provisioning via Deepgram's own API. There's no evidence of a Deepgram-native number-provisioning API endpoint. Missing for 10: a first-party phone-number provisioning API/console feature, and documentation of outbound call initiation directly through Deepgram rather than via a third-party telephony provider.
